actual_scope: For the selected m=73 complex stopped producer, jointly realize the completed ordinary-leaf interface on BOTH remaining ordinary leaf-call classes named by PR185 / coarse-depth stock: the peeled-atom residual (and n<73 stopped leaves) and the high-part exchange. Execute both through the published physical-ordinary Binary/fitted adapters, measure that Binary.run and Ordinary.run take no external stock/S_leaf argument (AST + live calls), and bind rho_peeled_highpart = 0 for the card. Cite A=0 and B_bits=2642 without recomputing them. Name the finite scalar/router guard for routing∪adapters inventory classes without phrase-assigning zeros as a measured discharge. Leave global kappa unchanged.
scope_change_reason: #3113 left rho unbound and #3421 left it open after A=0. Class-only S_leaf=1 packages for peeled and highpart alone were deferred for weak maintainer need (global rho still open). Citation-only inventory partitions for routing/adapters were deferred as phrase-matched zeros. This package answers the preferred joint obligation: engine-measured peeled+highpart binding with adapters that close the ordinary leaf path, composing rho_peeled_highpart=0 in one certificate.
bottleneck_link: The selected kappa binds through the m=73 complex producer. sigma <= (43/26)*(1-s)*(A+B) + rho needs an actual leaf-reserve binding; jointly closing the two remaining ordinary leaf classes removes their contribution to rho without changing kappa arithmetic.
stop_rule: Stop after joint peeled+highpart engine measurement, adapter stock-free AST/live checks, eight mutation controls, independent replay, and fitted suite. Do not recompute A=0 or B_bits=2642, do not phrase-assign routing/adapter zeros as a measured discharge, do not substitute 252 or 57604, and do not claim a new kappa.
evidence: verify.py (PASS_SELECTED_COMPLEX_PEELED_HIGHPART_RHO) re-hashes pinned engine inputs before import, replays peeled plan for every n<1533 and highpart 5x5 grid, executes 12+12 physical Binary cases with reserve extents 1 and 3, measures Binary/Ordinary APIs stock-free, rejects eight controls, and composes rho_peeled_highpart=0. Fitted suite restores parent-reserve through C0 on both classes. independent.py recomputes plans and payload hashes without the engine. No new kappa (0.001672660197076918).
